item.title: Plus Two girl student attacked with blade in Puri, hospitalised
item.description: A Plus Two student was injured after being attacked with a blade by unidentified miscreants while she was on her way to college in Odisha’s Puri district on Friday morning. The incident occurred at Muguria under Gop police station limits. According to reports, the student was travelling to appear for an examination when the attack took place.
